organization.name: Dokku project / maintainers
organization.notes: Community project with fiscal host Open Source Collective and Jose Diaz-Gonzalez as admin, rather than a verified separately incorporated venture. Donations and Pro sales are not equity rounds. Exact project-start year unresolved from checked primary pages;2014 copyright not treated as founding proof.

pricingTiers.name: Dokku core
pricingTiers.notes: Open-source core; own server capacity separate.
No explicit Most popular or Recommended plan designation verified in the pricing source; no plan inferred.

pricingTiers.name: Dokku Pro
pricingTiers.notes: One-time lifetime purchase; free upgrades forever; development-discount price may increase. No recurring monthly/annual fee.

pricingTiers.name: Pro volume/team license
pricingTiers.notes: Contact maintainer for volume or team pricing; not a hosted service or separate named Enterprise code edition.

moats.claim: A mature plugin ecosystem and Heroku-compatible operational model create transferable know-how; shell-based extensibility and standard containers constrain proprietary switching barriers.

productReasons.claim: Deploy Heroku-compatible projects by Git using buildpacks or a Dockerfile.
Extend application lifecycle operations with composable plugins and datastore integrations.
Manage process scaling, environment variables and live logs through Pro UI/API when graphical operation is needed.

sponsorship.notes: Corporate sponsorship source checked. Listed organizations explicitly support the project; customers and investors excluded.

requirements.notes: Docker-based application containers; nginx and cron support routing/jobs.
At least2GB per cluster node; other scheduler integrations separately documented.
Ubuntu22.04/24.04/26.04 or Debian11+; AMD64/ARM64. Domain recommended, IP-only possible.

requirements.condition: Only when deployed application requires chosen datastore
requirements.notes: Optional services, not Dokku platform state database requirements; do not install all.
Application-specific dependencies supplied during builds; no central SQL/cache required by base control plane.

resources.memory: Docker route1GB minimum or swap;K3s2GB per node
resources.notes: No universal CPU/disk minimum in checked guide; application builds require headroom beyond base memory.

selfHosting.notes: Default single-host Docker PaaS; SQL/cache services optional per app. Current install requires download then bootstrap/config steps, so not represented as a one-command installer.

options.name: DigitalOcean Dokku1-Click Droplet
options.notes: Homepage links official1-Click image. Listing version0.38.27 differs software table0.36.9; update to current stable after provision.

oneClickInstall.notes: Only verified official deployment options included; one-command installers labelled separately from one-click. Manual Docker Compose alone is not counted as one-click.
